cardSpecificBehavior: Wobbuffet PHF 36 Bide Barricade suppresses Abilities of all non-Psychic Pokémon in play, hand and discard, including the policy's own Snorlax PGO 55 Block; Psychic Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX is unaffected.

Stealthy Hood prevents effects of opponent Abilities on its attached Pokémon. Faba may remove an opponent Hood from a non-Psychic Pokémon with a valuable Ability; Radiant Eternatus CRZ 105 Climactic Gate is a priority target.
Jet Energy PAL 190 can promote Benched Wobbuffet; Temple of Sinnoh disables the Special Energy effect.
Alolan Muk SUM 58 Power of Alchemy suppresses Basic Wobbuffet and blocks the Wobbuffet line.
Rank-7 source deck contains no Vileplume. Nest Ball is an ordinary Item; no Vileplume Item-lock premise is used.
Palace Book SMP NAN25 is a no-prompt Item: draw three and end the turn; low priority only.

Field Blower GRI 125 discards Pokémon Tools and/or Stadiums in play, not Special Energy; the policy avoids a special-energy-only false positive and can remove its own Temple of Sinnoh when Jet Energy is held.
Chaotic Swell CEC 187 may replace the existing Stadium regardless of which player owns the Stadium-zone card.

Bellelba & Brycen-Man CEC 186 always mills three cards from each deck; its optional Bench reduction is selected only when the opponent has more than three Benched Pokémon, the actor has at most three, and three other cards remain in hand.
Target Whistle PHF 106 returns a Basic Pokémon from the opponent's discard pile to the opponent's Bench; the policy checks opponent Bench capacity and the fixed candidate's exact Basic printings.

Lusamine CIN 96 requires two Supporter/Stadium recovery choices; the root gate counts two supported rank-7 source-list targets and the prompt scorer excludes unsupported Items and the fail-closed Gladion path.
Girafarig's Get Lost prioritizes the candidate's Night Stretcher ASC 196 and Acerola BUS 112 as recovery targets.
